# array-pointer

Fix resolve(document, pointer) to read JSON objects/arrays via the plain JSON Pointer string form in sections 3–4, including token unescaping. Return the selected value; use ValueError for invalid syntax, missing members/elements, or traversal through scalars. In particular, consult the array-index grammar and treatment of "-". Object names are literal strings, even when they look like numbers. An empty pointer selects the root. No URI-fragment form or Unicode normalization; inputs are JSON-compatible values with unique object keys. Do not mutate document.

Run: `python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests`.
Source: https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc6901.txt (sections 3 Syntax and 4 Evaluation, especially array-index).
Preserve the interface and tests. No dependencies; scratch data only in the system temporary directory.
